handling_notes: ZIP archive: read pinned members in memory only (dbs external); never extract. 6 __MACOSX AppleDouble entries are excluded. No timestamps (rows paired by index within SessionID 1-5); units, coordinate frames, anchor geometry and tag/marker reference points are undeclared; README sample counts include the header row. UWB vs OptiTrack comparability is NOT established (RES-721 report): the frame-invariant best row lag is non-zero in 7/10 sessions (Walk 1,1,0,0,0; Trolley 3,3,3,4,3 rows), and the lag-aligned similarity frame fails in 10/10 (Walk translation ~0.27 in y; Trolley scale ~0.97, rotation up to 3.3 deg). Walk has 4 negative-range sentinels (e.g. -49.13); Trolley anchor-range geometry is inconsistent (fitted h^2 < 0). No UWB error metric may be reported; OptiTrack is not ground truth.
privacy_notes: Testbed radio-localisation data from Toshiba Research Europe: anonymous tag positions, ranges and radio features (CIR, PSA, AoA, RSSI) for 'walking' (tag carried by an unidentified person) and 'trolley' scenarios. No names, IDs, demographics, biometrics, dates or images. Not human-subject research data.
